acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass talks to Eyal Levin, who says his neighbor has been propagating a lie for years about one of the most contentious issues in New York: street parking.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: A stranger moves to Pawlet, Vermont. At first, his neighbors aren’t sure exactly what to make of him. And then, the problems start. Reporter Mike Giglio tells the story.
acts.title: Home, Home Near the Range

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Reporter Mike Giglio tries to answer the question: Just how much should the residents of Pawlet fear their new neighbor?
acts.title: Fear Thy Neighbor
